title: GPT-5.6: Frontier intelligence that scales with your ambition
notes: General-availability launch of the GPT-5.6 family (Sol, Terra, Luna). The article body states launch-day API pricing per 1M tokens of Sol $5 input / $30 output, Terra $2.50 input / $15 output, and Luna $1 input / $6 output. A banner dated 2026-07-30 records that Luna's price was later cut by ~80% and Terra's by ~20%, and links to openai-gpt-5-6-price-update; the body table therefore reflects the pre-cut prices.

title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6
notes: Records the 2026-07-30 price cut: from that date, API pricing per 1M tokens is Terra $2 input / $12 output and Luna $0.20 input / $1.20 output, while Sol pricing is unchanged. This supersedes the launch-day prices in openai-gpt-5-6-launch; both states are kept explicit.
